title: Preference changes can appear saved when Chrome storage rejects them
reproduction: Open Settings with a persisted Theme preference, then make chrome.storage.local.set reject for matrx.settings.v1.
Choose a different Theme and inspect the immediate control value, visible error feedback, and the actual persisted blob.
Reload Settings after storage recovers and compare the displayed choice with the previous in-memory choice; repeat with two rapid preference changes whose writes settle out of order.
expected: Each preference control reports failed persistence and offers a retry; rapid choices persist the latest successful intent and reload shows the saved choice.
actual: Source shows Settings controls call void-returning Zustand setters. The store updates in-memory state before persist calls async chromeLocalStorage.setItem; the setter does not return that Promise to the control or expose a save error. Rapid writes are not ordered at this boundary. Runtime RED and reload behavior have not yet been observed.
reproduction_status: source-confirmed unobserved persistence boundary; controlled runtime reproduction pending
severity: S2: a visible preference can fail to survive reload
priority: P1: make Settings preference persistence truthful

transition_history.reason: Independent source peer identified unobserved async Zustand preference writes across Settings controls.
Caller, store, adapter, and installed Zustand persist boundary traced; runtime rejection and rapid-write reproduction remain required.

closure_requirement: Controlled failing-then-passing component/store regression for storage rejection, retry, and rapid writes; independent review; exact-build browser reload acceptance. Do not close from source alone or from D86 desktop-control repair.
